title: Recreate this dance video shot-for-shot using @Image1 as the exact cast…
content:
Recreate this dance video shot-for-shot using @Image1 as the exact cast, outfits, and location, and @Video1 as the complete motion reference. Copy BOTH the dance choreography AND the camera work from @Video1 exactly.

@Image1 is the cast — three young Korean women, a dance crew, on a real residential street:
- LEFT: dark hair in a high bun, red one-shoulder crop top with a black mesh sleeve, black cargo joggers with red straps, black-and-red high-top sneakers.
- CENTER: white baseball cap, white bralette top, oversized light-grey wide-leg sweatpants, white shoulder bag, layered necklaces, white sneakers.
- RIGHT: long dark wavy hair, deep-red strapless tube top with a gold cross necklace, deep-red "Legend LA" baggy track pants, white sneakers.
Keep these three exact identities, faces, and outfits for the entire video.

COPY TWO LAYERS FROM @Video1 EXACTLY:

1. Dance motion — copy the choreography, timing, footwork, arm movements, formations, and hits exactly as performed. Map the reference's lead dancer's movements onto our CENTER dancer (white cap / grey sweats), and map the reference crew's movements onto our LEFT and RIGHT dancers, keeping all three in sync the same way the reference crew syncs. Match the sharp fast pace precisely — keep it fast and snappy, matching the reference speed exactly, not slower.

2. Camera motion — copy the camera work of @Video1 exactly: the same camera angles, the same camera movement and path, the same push-ins, pull-backs, pans, tilts, handheld sway, height changes, and framing at every moment. When the reference camera moves in, our camera moves in; when it pans or changes angle, ours does the same at the same time. The shot composition and camera choreography should match the reference frame-for-frame.

Keep the authentic look of @Image1 throughout: real residential street, soft daylight, houses and trees, handheld smartphone energy, natural lighting, authentic real-street dance cover, NOT glossy, NOT studio.

Our crew is only THREE dancers total — do not add extra dancers even if the reference has more; condense the reference crew's motion onto our two side dancers.

Mood: fast, powerful, confident, high-energy authentic street dance crew, shot exactly like the reference video.

Negative prompt: slow movement, slower than reference, off-beat timing, static locked-off camera, ignoring reference camera motion, only one dancer, two dancers, four or more dancers, big crowd, extra people, adding more crew, changing outfits, inconsistent faces, distorted hands, extra fingers, broken limbs, merged bodies, plastic skin, cartoon, anime, CGI, watermark, logo, subtitles, chaotic camera shake.

- IZQUIERDA: cabello oscuro en un moño alto, top corto rojo de un solo hombro con una manga de malla negra, joggers cargo negros con tiras rojas, zapatillas altas negras y rojas.
- CENTRO: gorra de béisbol blanca, top bralette blanco, pantalones de chándal anchos de pierna ancha en gris claro, bolso blanco al hombro, collares en capas, zapatillas blancas.
- DERECHA: cabello largo oscuro ondulado, top tubo sin tirantes rojo intenso con collar de cruz dorada, pantalones de chándal holgados rojo intenso con “Legend LA”, zapatillas blancas.
Mantén estas tres identidades, rostros y outfits exactos durante todo el video.

COPIA EXACTAMENTE DOS CAPAS DE @Video1:

1. Movimiento de baile — copia exactamente la coreografía, el timing, el footwork, los movimientos de brazos, las formaciones y los hits tal como se ejecutan. Mapea los movimientos de la bailarina principal de la referencia sobre nuestra bailarina del CENTRO (gorra blanca / sudadera gris), y mapea los movimientos del crew de la referencia sobre nuestras bailarinas de la IZQUIERDA y la DERECHA, manteniendo a las tres sincronizadas de la misma manera en que el crew de la referencia está sincronizado. Igualar con precisión el ritmo rápido y marcado — mantenlo rápido y ágil, coincidiendo exactamente con la velocidad de la referencia, no más lento.

2. Movimiento de cámara — copia exactamente el trabajo de cámara de @Video1: los mismos ángulos de cámara, el mismo movimiento y trayectoria de cámara, los mismos push-ins, pull-backs, pans, tilts, balanceo handheld, cambios de altura y encuadre en cada momento. Cuando la cámara de referencia se acerca, nuestra cámara se acerca; cuando hace un pan o cambia de ángulo, la nuestra hace lo mismo al mismo tiempo. La composición del plano y la coreografía de cámara deben coincidir con la referencia fotograma a fotograma.

Mantén durante todo el video el look auténtico de @Image1: calle residencial real, luz suave de día, casas y árboles, energía de smartphone handheld, iluminación natural, cover de baile auténtico en la calle real, NO glossy, NO estudio.

Nuestro crew es de solo TRES bailarinas en total — no añadas bailarinas extra aunque la referencia tenga más; condensa el movimiento del crew de la referencia sobre nuestras dos bailarinas laterales.

Mood: crew de baile callejero auténtico, rápido, potente, seguro, de alta energía, filmado exactamente como el video de referencia.

Negative prompt: movimiento lento, más lento que la referencia, timing fuera de ritmo, cámara estática fija, ignorar el movimiento de cámara de referencia, solo una bailarina, dos bailarinas, cuatro o más bailarinas, gran multitud, personas extra, añadir más crew, cambiar outfits, rostros inconsistentes, manos deformadas, dedos extra, extremidades rotas, cuerpos fusionados, piel plástica, cartoon, anime, CGI, watermark, logo, subtítulos, sacudidas caóticas de cámara.

비디오 전체에서 이 세 명의 정확한 신원, 얼굴, 의상을 유지하세요.

@Video1에서 두 가지 레이어를 정확히 복사하세요:

1. 댄스 모션 — 안무, 타이밍, 풋워크, 팔 동작, 포메이션, 히트를 정확히 그대로 복사하세요. 레퍼런스의 리드 댄서 동작은 우리 CENTER 댄서(흰 캡 / 회색 스웨트)에 매핑하고, 레퍼런스 크루의 동작은 우리 LEFT와 RIGHT 댄서에 매핑하되, 세 명 모두 레퍼런스 크루와 같은 방식으로 싱크를 맞추세요. 날카롭고 빠른 페이스를 정확히 맞추세요 — 레퍼런스 속도와 정확히 동일하게, 더 느리지 않게 빠르고 경쾌하게 유지하세요.

2. 카메라 모션 — @Video1의 카메라 워크를 정확히 그대로 복사하세요: 동일한 카메라 앵글, 동일한 카메라 움직임과 경로, 동일한 푸시인, 풀백, 팬, 틸트, 핸드헬드 스웨이, 높이 변화, 그리고 매 순간의 프레이밍까지 모두 동일하게. 레퍼런스 카메라가 앞으로 들어오면 우리 카메라도 앞으로 들어오고, 팬하거나 각도가 바뀌면 우리도 같은 순간에 똑같이 그렇게 하세요. 샷 구성과 카메라 안무는 프레임 단위로 레퍼런스와 일치해야 합니다.

@Image1의 진짜 느낌을 끝까지 유지하세요: 실제 주택가 거리, 부드러운 낮빛, 집들과 나무들, 핸드헬드 스마트폰 에너지, 자연광, 진짜 거리 댄스 커버의 느낌, 절대 매끈한 스튜디오 느낌이 아님.

우리 크루는 총 세 명의 댄서뿐입니다 — 레퍼런스에 더 많은 인원이 있더라도 추가 댄서를 넣지 마세요; 레퍼런스 크루의 모션은 우리 양쪽 댄서 두 명에게 압축해서 적용하세요.
